'''Baraboo biomold''' was a microscopic [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] organism native to [[Baraboo]]. Flecks of Baraboo biomold were among the millions of aquatic creatures living in the [[Royal Icqui Aquaria]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Baraboo biomold was first introduced in ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', a sourcebook for the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]], published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] on [[January 3]], [[2003]].<ref name="CW" />
